name: bitPermute
purpose: Table-driven bit (de)interleaver: permutes 54 values through the index table at 0x1006447c using the per-position masks at 0x10064454; param_1==1 unpacks values into bit fields, param_1==0 packs bit fields back into values.

name: bitUnpack
purpose: SEH-wrapped forward call to bitPermute (mode 1): unpacks the packed input array (param_6) into the bit-field outputs param_3/param_4/param_5.

name: bitPack
purpose: SEH-wrapped inverse call to bitPermute (mode 0): packs the bit-field inputs param_3/param_4/param_5 into the output array param_6.

name: codecTransformStage
purpose: Second codec stage: floating-point transform over the unpacked coefficients into integer output via __ftol.

name: codecSynthStage
purpose: Third codec stage: synthesis sub-tree (FUN_1003d1d0/d8d0 use sqrt, FUN_1003da50 uses log and a transcendental) producing the final sample buffer.

name: codecStageDispatch
purpose: Dispatcher for the codecProcessResource path: runs the fourteen transform/analysis sub-stages between 0x1003e600 and 0x10040da0.

name: floatFloorToInt
purpose: Rounds a floating-point value toward negative infinity (floor) and converts it to an integer (__ftol); a shared quantization helper in the codec.
